extracted.name: Never Enough Green Bean Casserole
extracted.description: This green bean casserole with Velveeta is NOT your usual plain green bean casserole. This recipe started with my great-aunt and has been passed around our family for years. People tasting it for the first time ALWAYS want the recipe!
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (4 ounce) can mushroom stems and pieces, drained
2 (15 ounce) cans cut green beans, drained
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).

Heat condensed soup in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in processed cheese and bacon bits; continue stirring until completely melted. Remove from heat; stir in mushrooms and green beans until evenly coated.
Pour mixture into a casserole dish; top with fried onions, leaving a 1-inch border along the sides.
Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and bubbly, 25 to 30 minutes. Check near the end of cooking to ensure onions aren't getting too brown.
